            d.setdefault(c,[]).append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols),n['pixels']))

def dotpos(f):
    # dot is the r-node inside the piece (row>33)
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='r' and n['boundary'][0][0]>33:

def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c in ('Y','N','O','S','r') and n['pixels']>=1 and n['boundary'][0][0]<50:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            d.setdefault(c,[]).append((min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols),n['pixels']))
    return d
def dotpos(f):
    # dot is the r-node inside the piece (row>33)
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='r' and n['boundary'][0][0]>33:
            return n['boundary'][0]
    return None
